TestScope: Native page rendering and fixture-backed UI interaction checks only; no cleanup of real user data.

Search matches path or app case-insensitively and clearing restores rows

Gaps: Automated native WPF checks use generated rows and off-screen windows, not a full manual interaction pass on every Windows configuration.
Actual uninstall is intentionally absent. Real personal-file cleanup and organizer moves were not invoked by UI checks.
